Toxic Terminator features on-line hints
to keep you on the right path.  Enough
is left out to keep things interesting.
 
This module is separated from the main
game so you will use it less often.  It
has some suggestions on how to proceed.
And for the really stumped, there are
some solutions.
 
▒▓ ▓▒
▒▓█▓▒
▒▓ ▓▒
 
In this adventure, you guide the hero,
Smiley Guy, as he rescues his girl friend
and saves Earth from an evil machine,
called the Toxic Terminator.
 
Before he can find them, Smiley must
find five power crystals and solve other
puzzles.
 
▒▓ ▓▒
▒▓█▓▒
▒▓ ▓▒
The game breaks down into three major 
parts.  If you need help, choose the
room you want from the list below:
 
Part 1 ▐ Above Ground 
 ▐                
Part 2 ▐ Under Ground 
 ▐                
Part 3 ▐ Above Earth  
↑↓ choose, Enter select, Esc close
